title: 第六十四回 玄冥冰棺第六十三回 鬽蠹子
slug: 驭音心经第七十回狼心逞乱
lines: “眼下该当如何？”
“尚缺一物——玄冥冰棺，方可施术。”
“玄冥冰棺？”
“正是。”
“此棺何处可寻？”
“寻它不难，只需穹蓝溟山一趟，去访吾儿。吾儿春生。专精于此，求得并非难事，但恐延误救治。”
听闻除绛鬽蠹子，尚需玄冥冰棺，灸世仙人沉吟不语。忽而一抚掌，眼中一亮：“昔年吾在先帝陵中受罚，曾见一棺，通体澄澈幽蓝，似冰如玉，宛若凝雪，不知可是此棺？”
慕府老君遂问：“它可是无光自亮，触目生寒？”灸世仙人连连颔首，慕府老君灿颜：“那便是了！玄冥冰棺举世罕有，能得之者寥寥！”灸世仙人初闻一喜，旋即神色凝重：“冰棺虽近，然能否一用，还需老朽面君盛陈。”
灵堂之中，四皇子心绪杂乱。外间消息接踵而至，或喜或忧，让他甚是分心。跪伏身后的老八、老九，见太监如走马灯般将一张张密条呈给四皇子，而他只是静扫一眼，默然不语，阅罢即焚。两人互换一下眼神，心中各自暗中思罗。好不容易捱到午膳，四皇子起身匆匆离去。老八老九即刻凑在一处，窃窃低语。
四皇子绕过勤政殿，来至伴明居，早有大臣跪伏廊下，等候召见。四皇子未发一语，挑帘步入春暖阁，褪去龙靴，盘腿于御榻上坐下。宫女们轻手轻脚摆上御膳，一名小太监抱来一叠文书，搁在案边。依照新皇惯例，四皇子要边用膳边阅奏章，同时召见议事大臣。
“李总管，”四皇子吩咐：“你让其他人先退下，只传邓仙医进来，朕今天有点乏累。”
“嗻。”新任总管太监躬身退下，不多时便引邓仙医入内。四皇子并未抬头，冷声发问：“仙丹既已取回，邓仙医为何还不施术救人？”
“万岁，老臣正为此事而来。”
“不幸中的大幸，慕府老君亲自送丹，她识得鬽蠹子。祛除此怪，尚需玄冥冰棺。老臣为此特来面君，恳请圣上恩准，借先帝陵中冰棺一用。”
四皇子闻言，思忖一下，未置可否，只抬手一挥：“朕知晓了，你先退下吧。”
“陛下……？”灸世仙人抬头，一脸诧异：“孤仙人命悬一线，救治刻不容缓！若无冰棺护体，仓促施术，恐留后遗。还请圣上明断，莫要迟疑！”
四皇子心事重重，放下奏折，没有言声，只是起身踱步，似有忧虑。灸世仙人情急：“万岁，此事耽搁不得，还请万岁速做决断！”四皇子转过身，神色肃穆：“朕知晓了，邓仙医。你且先回，朕今夜回府，自有定断。”
灸世仙人闻言大惊：“陛下，为何还要待至深夜？只怕因此错过时机，悔之晚矣！”四皇子仰起脸，眉间凝霜：“邓仙医，朕比你心急。然你应知，大行皇帝陵寝，凡人禁地，先帝灵棺，岂容他人沾染！”
邓仙医还欲再说，四皇子轻轻摆手：“不必再说，朕知晓你想说什么，你不了解朕，亦不了解朕与孤仙弟情谊，你容朕三思。”
邓仙医坚持：“陛下，老臣此来，容妃娘娘托臣代其一问。”
“何问？”四皇子沉声发问。
“娘娘问，皇上允是不允？”
四皇子闻言一笑，思量片刻道：“你且先回，转告容妃，朕要当面回她。”
邓仙医方退，门外李总管禀报：“陛下，十三爷求见。”
“宣他进来，朕正欲找他。”
门帘一挑，十三皇子肩上带雪，携一身寒，迈步而入。四皇子见状一笑，问：“外面又落雪了？”十三皇子拍拍肩上的雪，点点头，见桌上饭菜一筷未动，便问：“万岁还未用膳？”四皇子颔首：“朕心中有事，正欲找你，你来的正好。”
十三皇子凝色发问：“万岁，为何不允邓仙医？”
四皇子闻言一笑：“你怎知朕未允他？”
十三皇子道：“臣弟方才撞见，问他，他只是摇头叹息，避而未答。臣弟故而猜疑。”
四皇子轻叹一声，望向十三弟：“连你也这般看朕？以为朕见死不救，另有所图？”十三皇子摇头，四皇子却是点头：“非朕不允，只是朕在思量，如何才好万全行事。”言罢，取过案上一份奏折，交给十三弟：“看看吧，这是年终至的辩罪折子，前线又吃败仗了。”
“啊！”十三皇子闻言一惊，接过细看。但见奏折上呈文如下：“皇上圣明，奴才罪该万死，欺君罔上，矫报军情。诚如陛下所言，奴才亦确有难言之隐！”
“……契麾迩罕帐下妖僧完延秃匂，法力玄通，能召阴兵、呼风唤雨。初与之战，其扬尘施雾，阴兵压阵，黑风卷地，使我军将士惊惶，以致马失蹄，阵失位，被其挫败，先输一阵。”
“……臣思一良计，使一队兵，皆持铜镜，身着红衣，推四轮车，上载神像，唤作‘羿阳降魔阵’。再与之战，等阴兵出，吾出其阵，恍闪铜镜，施火箭，泼猪血，溃散阴兵。随后祭出骑兵，擎旗掩杀，大破敌阵。未料，那完延秃匂竟骑象而至，身后更率一阵，驱黑熊于阵前，兽吼震天，地动山摇。我军将士胆寒，先胜后败，不敢再战。”
content_en:
"What should we do now?"
"There is still one thing missing - the Xuanming Ice Coffin before we can perform the technique."
"Xuanming Ice Coffin?"
"Exactly."
"Where can I find this coffin?"
"It's not difficult to find it. You only need to go to Qionglanming Mountain to visit my son. My son will be born in spring. I specialize in this, so it is not difficult to find it, but I may delay the treatment."
Hearing that to get rid of the crimson beetles, a Xuanming ice coffin is needed, the moxibustion immortal was silent. Suddenly he touched his palm and his eyes lit up: "In the past, when I was punished in the late emperor's mausoleum, I once saw a coffin. The whole body was clear and blue, like ice, jade, and condensed snow. I wonder if it is this coffin?"
Mr. Mufu then asked: "It has no light and is cold to the eyes?" The Immortal of the Moxibustion World nodded repeatedly, and the Mr. Mufu said with a bright face: "That's it! The Xuanming Ice Coffin is rare in the world, and only a few can get it!" The Immortal of the Moxibustion World was delighted when he first heard it, and immediately looked solemn: "Although the ice coffin is close, whether it can be used, I still need to show it to you."
In the mourning hall, the fourth prince was in a confused mood. News from outside came one after another, either good or bad, which made him very distracted. Lao Ba and Lao Jiu, who were kneeling behind them, saw the eunuch presenting the secret notes to the fourth prince like a revolving lantern, but he just glanced at them quietly, remained silent, and burned them after reading them. The two of them exchanged glances, thinking secretly in their hearts. After finally getting to lunch, the fourth prince got up and left in a hurry. The eight and nine old men immediately gathered together and whispered.
The fourth prince bypassed the Qinzheng Hall and came to Banmingju. There were already ministers kneeling in the corridor, waiting to be summoned. Without saying a word, the fourth prince walked into Chunnuang Pavilion through the curtain, took off his dragon boots, and sat down cross-legged on the imperial couch. The palace maids laid out the imperial meal with gentle hands, and a young eunuch brought a stack of documents and placed them beside the desk. According to the new emperor's practice, the fourth prince had to read the memorial while having a meal and summon the ministers at the same time.
"Mr. Li," the fourth prince ordered, "please ask the others to leave first, and only call Dr. Deng to come in. I am a little tired today."
"Hey." The new chief eunuch bowed and stepped back, and soon he ushered Doctor Deng Xian in. The fourth prince did not raise his head and asked coldly: "Since the elixir has been retrieved, why hasn't Dr. Deng performed any surgery to save the patient?"
"Long live, I am here for this matter."
"It is a great blessing in the misfortune that Mr. Mufu personally sent the elixir to her, and she recognized the beetle. To get rid of this strange thing, we still need the Xuanming Ice Coffin. For this reason, I came to see you and begged the Holy One for permission to borrow the ice coffin in the late emperor's mausoleum."
When the fourth prince heard the words, he thought for a moment, and without commenting, he just raised his hand and waved: "I understand, please step back first."
"Your Majesty...?" The Moxibustion World Immortal raised his head with a surprised look on his face: "The life of the solitary Immortal hangs by a thread, and treatment cannot be delayed! If there is no ice coffin to protect the body, and the surgery is performed in a hurry, there may be sequelae. Please make a clear decision, don't hesitate!"
The fourth prince was preoccupied. He put down the memorial and said nothing. He just stood up and walked around, seemingly worried. The Moxibustion World Immortal was anxious: "Long live this matter, we can't delay, please make a decision quickly!" The fourth prince turned around with a solemn expression: "I understand, Dr. Deng. You go back first, I will go back to my house tonight and make my own decision."
The Moxibustion World Immortal was shocked when he heard this: "Your Majesty, why do you have to stay until late at night? I'm afraid that you will miss the opportunity and regret it too late!" The fourth prince raised his face, with frost on his eyebrows: "Immortal Doctor Deng, I am more anxious than you. But you should know that the mausoleum of the Daxing Emperor is a forbidden place for mortals, and the late emperor's coffin is not allowed to be contaminated by others!"
Immortal doctor Deng wanted to say more, but the fourth prince waved his hand gently: "No need to say any more, I know what you want to say. You don't understand me, and you don't understand my friendship with Brother Gu Xian. Please allow me to think twice."
Dr. Deng Xian insisted: "Your Majesty, I am here. Please ask me to ask questions on my behalf."
"What's the question?" the fourth prince asked in a deep voice.
"The empress asked, does the emperor agree or not?"
The fourth prince smiled when he heard this, thought for a moment and said, "Go back first and tell Concubine Rong that I will answer her face to face."
Doctor Deng Xian retreated, and Manager Li reported outside the door: "Your Majesty, the Thirteenth Master wants to see you."
"Inform him to come in, I am looking for him."
The door curtain was raised, and the Thirteenth Prince stepped in with snow on his shoulders and a cold body. Seeing this, the fourth prince smiled and asked, "Is it snowing outside again?" The thirteenth prince patted the snow on his shoulders and nodded. Seeing that not a single chopstick of the food on the table had been touched, he asked, "Hail, haven't you eaten yet?" The fourth prince nodded: "I have something on my mind, and I was looking for you. You came just in time."
The Thirteenth Prince looked calm and asked: "Long live, why don't you allow the immortal doctor Deng?"
The fourth prince smiled when he heard this: "How did you know that I didn't agree with him?"
The Thirteenth Prince said: "I just bumped into him and asked him, but he just shook his head and sighed, avoiding the answer. That's why I became suspicious."
The fourth prince sighed softly and looked at the thirteenth brother: "Do you even look at me like this? Do you think that I will not save you and have other plans?" The thirteenth prince shook his head, but the fourth prince nodded: "It's not that I don't agree, it's just that I'm thinking about how to act safely." After saying that, he took a copy of the memorial on the case and gave it to the thirteenth brother: "Take a look, this is the plea statement at the end of the year, and the front line has been defeated again."
"Ah!" The Thirteenth Prince was shocked when he heard this, and took a closer look. But I saw the following text in the memorial: "Your Majesty, the emperor is wise, the slave deserves to die for his crime, deceiving the emperor, neglecting his superiors, and falsely reporting the military situation. As your majesty said, the slave does have an unspeakable secret!"
"... The demon monk Wanyan Bald in Qihu Youhan's tent has profound magic power and can summon Yin soldiers and call for wind and rain. When we first fought against him, he raised dust and mist, Yin soldiers overwhelmed the formation, and black wind swept the ground. Our soldiers were frightened, causing their horses to stumble and their formations to lose their positions. We were defeated by him and lost for a while."
"... I thought of a good plan and sent a group of soldiers, all holding bronze mirrors and dressed in red, to push a four-wheeled cart and load the statue of the god. I called it the 'Yi Yang Conquering Demon Array'. Then I fought with them. When the Yin soldiers came out, I came out of the formation, flashed the bronze mirrors, fired rockets, splashed pig blood, and defeated the Yin. Soldiers. Then they sent out their cavalry and raised their flags to cover up the enemy's formation. Unexpectedly, the Wanyan Tujiao came with an elephant and drove a black bear in front of the formation. The beast's roar shook the sky and the mountains shook. Our soldiers were frightened. They won first and then lost, and they did not dare to fight again. "
